name: Gargüera de la Vera (Spain)
description: Divided by a green diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, white above and yellow below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Gargüera de la Vera (a cauldron between flowers on green).
history: Municipal flag of Gargüera de la Vera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
